explication: Trakt Web is a SvelteKit frontend for browsing media and viewing personal media insights. The main evidenced runtime path is user-facing lists consuming paginated query results; other documented-by-tree capabilities include media presentation, account actions, streaming-service management, analytics, and preview-feature state. The sampled files establish query and streaming-action wiring, but not route composition or the full request-to-API implementation, so those connections are left out where ownership is unclear.
